findings.claim: copy-skills can write through a symlinked destination directory outside the intended home skill roots.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria require copy-skills to "copy — never symlink" and the proposal's Security section says it "writes only under `<home>/.agents/skills/<name>` and `<home>/.claude/skills/<name>`"; however `drift()` builds `destination = path.join(home, root, 'skills', name)` without lstatting any destination directory, `differs()` only lstat-checks the final file path, and the fix writes `atomicWrite(to, readFileSync(from))`, so an existing symlink at `<home>/.agents/skills/<name>` or an intermediate directory is followed.
findings.suggested_fix: Before reporting or writing, lstat every destination parent component that is under the doctor's control (`.agents`, `.claude`, `skills`, and `<name>`); refuse or report fail if any is a symlink, and ensure writes occur only inside real directories whose resolved path remains under the expected home skill root.

findings.claim: The service warning tells users to run a non-existent `scripts/services.mjs` command.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria for optional components require a `warn` "with the next step" when a service is absent or unreachable, but `mini-service-surreal-memory` and `mini-service-liter-llm` set `start: 'node scripts/services.mjs up ...'` while the packet's file_tree lists no `scripts/services.mjs`.
findings.suggested_fix: Point the warning at an existing service-start command in this repository, or make the check skip with a reason until the service-management script it references has landed.
